title: Boba Fett Atop his Bantha
description: Another soak in the bacta pod brings another glance into the past. Having been accepted into the Tusken Raider tribe, Boba Fett proudly strode atop a massive bantha, while the entirety of the encampment looked on. Entering Mos Eisley, Fett goes in search of the Pyke Syndicate. Upon meeting with the Pyke Boss, he learns that protection is already being paid to the Kintan Striders Gang for Tusken territory. It is a wrong Boba plans to swiftly rectify.
